description: This file contains functions and classes for fuzzing PyTorch tensors, including generating random tensor sizes, strides, data types, and scalar values for testing purposes. It also defines configuration options and specifications for tensors and scalars.

classes.name: FuzzerConfig
classes.description: Global configuration for tensor fuzzing behavior, including options for real values and complex dtype inclusion.

classes.name: TensorSpec
classes.description: Specification for a tensor argument, including size, stride, and dtype.

classes.name: ScalarSpec
classes.description: Specification for a scalar argument, including dtype and optional constant value.

methods.name: fuzz_torch_tensor_type
methods.description: Randomly selects and returns a PyTorch tensor data type based on a template.

methods.name: fuzz_tensor_size
methods.description: Generates a random tensor shape with up to max_dims dimensions and sizes.

methods.name: fuzz_valid_stride
methods.description: Generates valid stride patterns for a given tensor size.

methods.name: fuzz_tensor
methods.description: Creates a strided tensor with fuzzed size, stride, and dtype, optionally seeded for reproducibility.

methods.name: fuzz_tensor_simple
methods.description: Returns a tensor with fuzzed properties, without the seed.

methods.name: fuzz_non_contiguous_dense_tensor
methods.description: Generates a non-contiguous but dense tensor, optionally with specified size and dtype.

methods.name: fuzz_scalar
methods.description: Creates a Python scalar value from a ScalarSpec, optionally seeded.

methods.name: specs_compatible
methods.description: Checks if two tensor or scalar specifications are compatible.
